description.value: A full-service lakeshore resort on Kootenay Lake offering treed and waterfront tent sites alongside a pub, marina, boat rentals, heated pool, and private beach; Ainsworth Hot Springs is a short ride up BC-31, though tent rates of $38–42/night reflect the resort price point.

address.value: 4112 BC-31, Ainsworth Hot Springs, BC V0G 1A0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Woodbury Resort & Marina is an active year-round resort on Kootenay Lake offering RV sites (30 amp full hookups), tent sites, cabins, and motel rooms, with 2025 and 2026 rates published. JB's Pub & Restaurant is on-site (Food nearby=true), a laundromat is referenced on the front page and footer (Laundry=true), the marina page lists 'Ice' among supplies (Ice=true), potable water is mentioned at the marina cleaning station (Potable water=true), and booking deposits/credit card requirements confirm reservations are accepted. No hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-related amenities are mentioned.
concerns: OSM record is very sparse — missing address, phone, and email that the website clearly provides.
No hiker/biker-specific tent sites mentioned; cyclists would use standard tent sites.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active year-round campground on Highway 31 along Kootenay Lake with tent sites, on-site food, laundry, and a country store — a strong fit for touring cyclists on the Kootenay Lake corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also has a country store for snacks and supplies, a heated pool in summer, and motel/cabin accommodations as alternatives to camping. Toll-free number also available: 1-877-353-7717. Email: woodburyresort@netidea.com.
